provenance.paper_title: TARIC: Memory-Augmented Traversability-Aware Outdoor VLN under Interrupted Semantic Cues

evidence.section: Full paper: B. 3D Semantic Cue Memory
evidence.paraphrase: Semantic cue extraction produces 2D cue direction when visible.; Cue evidence is lifted into a world-aligned 3D memory.; Particle-like cue memory updates as the robot moves and cues appear/disappear.. spatial query over the map conditioned on current observation and instruction.
During operation, TARIC applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to World-aligned 3D cue memory particles/belief; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

evidence.section: Full paper: B. 3D Semantic Cue Memory
evidence.paraphrase: During operation, TARIC applies evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence to World-aligned 3D cue memory particles/belief; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (World-aligned 3D cue memory particles/belief) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
